scope: Muçum only; shadow artifact and offline diagnostics, never a published forecast

formula.alpha: 0.5 for 0 < real_lead <= 1; 0.25 * (3 - real_lead) for 1 < real_lead < 3; 0 for real_lead >= 3
formula.direction: rising if known slope > +0.05m/h, falling if < -0.05m/h, stable otherwise

rationale: A fixed conservative blend limits extrapolation to the two short real-lead bands suggested by the preceding exploratory diagnostic. The 0.50m cap uses the goal's existing absolute-error tolerance, not a search over this episode. No parameter fitting or alternate coefficients will be selected using the results.
input_requirements: Timezone-aware reference, issue, anchor, past and target timestamps.
Reference is an exact hour; anchor timestamp equals reference; 0 <= issue - reference < 1h.
Anchor and exact anchor-minus-1h levels are finite, nonnegative and belong to station 86510000.
Both observations have explicit received_at <= issued_at and received_at >= observation timestamp, source evidence identifiers and approved quality.
No interpolation, stale fallback, missing-value imputation, future receipt or conflicting duplicate at the required timestamp.
Every baseline point is finite, nonnegative, unique and strictly future at issue; unavailable inputs yield no candidate points.
historical_exception: Offline evaluator alone may set allow_legacy_unverified=true to inspect preserved D1 values with created_at. These lack immutable version/QC proof and are labelled legacy_unverified; they cannot count as prospective goal evidence.

groups: exact same latest eligible issue at each minimum real lead used by preceding audit
evaluation.selection: All preserved Muçum issue/target pairs; availability determined without targets; report exact observed targets separately from future/missing targets.
evaluation.limitations: One episode already inspected, not an independent holdout. Correlated emissions and horizons are not independent events. No fitting, model loading, network, publication or promotion.

promotion_requirements: Never promote automatically from this replay or from headline aggregate improvement.
Freeze version and formula before evaluation on whole independent flood events reserved from all development, with immutable observations as received.

Demonstrate improved MAE and +/-0.50m hit rate at each affected real horizon, including rising, falling, peak transitions and floods, without increased maximum error or absolute bias in any sufficiently supported group.
Report blocked/missing forecasts with the complete scheduled-opportunity denominator; no improvement obtained by quietly dropping failures.
Unaffected leads >=3h must remain bit-for-bit equal to the frozen baseline.
Run prospective shadow validation before any separately reviewed model release.
The >=98% goal still requires its established >=1000 verifiable prospective pairs per horizon and >=10 independent certified flood events; this diagnostic supplies neither.
